name: add
summary: Out = A + B (ND contiguous, flattened numel). Variants: f32 naive, f16 naive, f16 half2(vec2) fastpath when numel even + 4B aligned.
contract: - elementwise add on flattened numel() (ND supported)
abi: Note: launcher does not read attr; exec can pass schema 0 or anything (but variant matching uses expected_attr_schema_id==0).
notes: Common check: dtype match, contiguous, shapes match, numel>0
Launch: threads=256, blocks=ceil(N/256) (current code does NOT cap blocks; consider cap=65535 for huge N).
F16 half2 path: requires numel even + A/B/Out pointers 4B aligned; reinterpret as __half2 and run N2 threads.
Current kernels are simple 1D if(i<N) body (no grid-stride). For very large tensors, consider grid-stride + blocks cap.

variants.name: add_f32_naive
supported: A,B same shape; Out same shape

variants.name: add_f16_naive
supported: A,B same shape; Out same shape

variants.name: add_f16_vec2_half2
supported: A,B same shape; Out same shape

suites.name: basic_nd_shapes
suites.desc: Common ND shapes; compare f16 naive vs half2 eligibility and f32 baseline.

suites.name: alignment_probe
suites.desc: Force pointer alignment/misalignment to verify half2 gating.

cases.label: Aligned pointers (expected half2 if N even)

experiments.title: Add half2(vec2) fastpath
experiments.change: Introduce add_f16_vec2_half2 variant: N even + 4B aligned pointers; reinterpret to __half2 and use __hadd2.
experiments.why: Improve bandwidth utilization for f16 elementwise add.
experiments.hypothesis: For large N, half2 path increases GB/s and reduces latency vs f16 naive.
experiments.proof: Check selected variant + ncu dram throughput; compare gld/gst efficiency; validate correctness vs reference.
experiments.next: Switch to grid-stride loop + blocks cap; try vectorized loads (ld.global.v2) and unroll.

experiments.title: Stability for huge N (blocks cap + grid-stride)
experiments.change: Replace if(i<N) with grid-stride loop; cap blocks to 65535.
experiments.why: Current blocks=ceil(N/256) can exceed CUDA grid limits for very large tensors.
experiments.hypothesis: No perf regression; avoids launch failure at large N.
experiments.proof: Test N >> 2^31; verify launch success; ncu runtime similar.
experiments.next: Consider 2D mapping for better L2 locality if needed (usually unnecessary for pure elementwise).

measurements.notes: Elementwise: report latency + effective GB/s. TFLOP/s optional.
